sloka: मातरं पितरं यो हि आचार्यं चावमन्यते ।स पश्यति फलं तस्य प्रेतराजवशं गतः ।। ७.१५.२१ ॥
transliteration: mātaraṁ pitaraṁ yo hi ācāryaṁ cāvamanyate ।sa paśyati phalaṁ tasya pretarājavaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 7.15.21 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, whoever disrespects their mother, father, and teacher will see the consequences of such actions after falling under the dominion of Yama, the king of the dead.
